target.title: feat(ios): read-only offline cache for chat sessions and transcripts
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Resolves a problem where opening the chat tab showed a blank transcript until the gateway responded, and showed nothing at all when the gateway was unreachable. All chat state was in memory only, so cold opens and offline periods left users staring at an empty screen even for conversations they had just been reading.

Part of #100194

## Why This Change Was Made

Adds a small, disposable, read-only offline cache of recent chat sessions and transcripts, scoped per paired gateway identity. Cold opens paint the last known transcript immediately; authoritative gateway history then replaces it through the existing reconciliation path. Post-send incomplete history cannot cache optimistic echoes or erase the last canonical snapshot.

The store is versioned SQLite with drop-and-rebuild on mismatch, bounded retention, no migrations, and no new dependency. Text rows only; attachment payloads are stripped. iOS opens the database with Complete file protection, treats locked-device protected-data unavailability as a temporary cache miss, and retires every cache handle before reset removes the whole database and sidecars.

## User Impact

The chat tab renders the last known conversation immediately on launch, and recent sessions remain browsable while disconnected. Sending stays disabled until the connection is healthy. Switching gateways rebuilds the view model immediately, while reset/forget physically removes cached conversation text.

## Evidence

- `swift test --filter ChatTranscriptCacheStoreTests` — 11/11 pass, including bounds, gateway scoping, corruption rebuild, attachment stripping, retirement, late-write suppression, and physical whole-file reset.
- `swift test --filter ChatViewModelTranscriptCacheTests` — 6/6 pass, including cache-first cold open, offline browsing, canonical write-through, optimistic-echo exclusion, and incomplete-empty post-send cache preservation.
- Blacksmith Testbox through Crabbox `tbx_01kwrvdak8yxww01vn1mx8mg7s`: native i18n inventory clean; full docs formatting/lint/MDX/link/map checks clean.
- Fresh Codex autoreview after all fixes: clean, no accepted/actionable findings (`patch is correct`, confidence 0.78).
- Local exact app-scheme build reached package resolution but this Mac lacks the required watchOS 26.5 runtime; the current-head `ios-build` and `macos-swift` GitHub lanes are the authoritative compile gates.

Live visual proof is requested below for simulator cold-open/offline/reconnect behavior. Current-head CI is in progress.
